info.title: Yapaja Go Core API
info.description: Automatisch generiert aus den tatsächlich registrierten Fastify-Routen (apps/core/src/index.ts, onRouteHook) und den @yapaja/shared-JSON-Schemas (packages/shared/src/schemas/). Quelle der Wahrheit ist der Code, nicht dieses Dokument -- bei Verdacht auf Abweichung: `pnpm openapi:check` (CI-Gate "Spec aktuell") bzw. docs/03-api-spec.md für den erzählenden Überblick. WebSocket (/ws/v1) und MQTT sind hier NICHT modelliert (OpenAPI eignet sich dafür nicht) -- siehe docs/03-api-spec.md §3/§4.

200.description: Erfolgreiche Antwort (Schema noch nicht kuratiert -- siehe apps/core/src/openapi/paths.ts)

alt.description: Altitude in meters above mean sea level

avg_speed_kmh.description: Average speed in km/h for ETA calculation (40–130)

is_active.description: Whether this profile is currently active

origin.description: Starting point: LatLng or "current" for device position

profile_id.description: UUID of vehicle profile to use

alternatives.description: Number of alternative routes to return (0–3)

exclude_locations.description: Optional point locations to exclude from routing for this request only (temporary avoidance, not persisted)

items.description: Closed ring of LatLng points forming a polygon to exclude

exclude_polygons.description: Optional polygons to exclude from routing for this request only (temporary avoidance, not persisted)

avoid_overrides.description: Optional per-request overrides of the active profile's avoid flags; the profile itself is not modified

heading.description: Optional current vehicle heading in degrees (0 = North). On a reroute request it biases the origin edge in the direction of travel so the first instruction points forward.

duration_s.description: Total route duration in seconds (Valhalla time, calibrated)

distance_m.description: Length of maneuver segment in meters

is_usable.description: Whether vehicle can use this lane

duration_s.description: Planned duration of this maneuver segment in seconds (Valhalla time), optional (E04-T2)

kmh.description: Speed limit in km/h (5–130 or null for unknown)

distance_m.description: Length of maneuver segment in meters

is_usable.description: Whether vehicle can use this lane

duration_s.description: Planned duration of this maneuver segment in seconds (Valhalla time), optional (E04-T2)

route_id.description: ID of current route or null

distance_m.description: Length of maneuver segment in meters

is_usable.description: Whether vehicle can use this lane

duration_s.description: Planned duration of this maneuver segment in seconds (Valhalla time), optional (E04-T2)

distance_to_maneuver_m.description: Distance to next maneuver in meters or null

distance_remaining_m.description: Total distance remaining to destination or null

duration_remaining_s.description: Estimated time to destination in seconds or null

eta.description: Estimated time of arrival, UTC ISO 8601 with offset (client formats locally, W-22), or null

speed_kmh.description: Current speed in km/h or null

speed_limit_kmh.description: Speed limit from map data (5–130 or null for unknown)

altitude_m.description: Current altitude in meters above mean sea level or null

destination.description: Destination with coordinates and optional name or null

distance_m.description: Length of maneuver segment in meters

is_usable.description: Whether vehicle can use this lane

duration_s.description: Planned duration of this maneuver segment in seconds (Valhalla time), optional (E04-T2)

distance_m.description: Distance to the maneuver at the moment this instruction fired, in meters

error.description: Error object with code, message, and optional details

source.description: Backend that produced this result; "lite" = offline SQLite/FTS5 fallback used when Photon is down/disabled (E05-T5, W-12)

out_of_coverage.description: True if the result lies outside all installed map regions (Vorgriff W-09)

icon.description: Free-form icon key/emoji shown as the favorite chip icon

category.description: Favorite category; "home" may exist at most once

query.description: Raw search query text, or null if this entry is a picked destination

destination.description: Picked destination, or null if this entry is a raw search query

id.description: Reverse-DNS-ish identifier; becomes the data/addons/{id} directory name
